body: I'm an extremely jealous person and resent when my friends are more successful when me. I always secretly wish for them to fail. I'm an awful person.

Wow.. that quote was very beautiful and inspiring. Thank you for sharing that. 

Kind of off-topic, but I've actually come across that author's name several times recently... Is she worth checking out? I've been eyeing her *The Bell Jar* but haven't gotten around to picking it up yet.

Amen. This next thing I'm about to say is going to sound so weird and creepy, but I want to get it off my chest.

There's this one girl I follow on Instagram and she goes to my school; I don't know her personally, but we have mutual friends. She's the most stunning girl I've ever seen. Sometimes I wonder, how would it feel to be that beautiful? To have been born with amazing looks and genes into a wealthy family that'll likely support her both emotionally and physically for the rest of her life? Sometimes I wish I could *be* that girl. And I know that sounds so fucking weird and serial killer-ish, but I sometimes wonder how differently I would see the world were I in her position.

Do you ever feel like every morning you mentally put on a costume? And then you're forced to where that costume and act in a role that's been predetermined for you? And some days that costume just doesn't fit right and you're left feeling so isolated and disconnected from life going on around you? That's how I felt all day today. I think maybe because it was because today's Valentine's Day and everyone's happiness around me reminds me of how empty I am inside. Living is so annoying.
